description: This file defines a function to register pre-action hooks for a CLI program, handling setup tasks such as setting process titles, managing environment variables, loading configuration and plugin modules, and controlling logging behavior before command execution.

methods.name: setProcessTitleForCommand
methods.description: Sets the process title based on the command's hierarchy and CLI name.

methods.name: shouldBypassConfigGuard
methods.description: Determines if the config guard should be bypassed for a given command path.

methods.name: loadConfigGuardModule
methods.description: Lazily imports the config guard module.

methods.name: loadPluginRegistryModule
methods.description: Lazily imports the plugin registry module.

methods.name: resolvePluginRegistryScope
methods.description: Determines the scope ('channels' or 'all') for plugin registration based on command path.

methods.name: shouldLoadPluginsForCommand
methods.description: Decides if plugins should be loaded for a specific command based on command path and output mode.

methods.name: shouldAllowInvalidConfigForAction
methods.description: Checks if invalid config is allowed for a given action command and command path.

methods.name: getCliLogLevel
methods.description: Gets the CLI log level setting from the root command options.

methods.name: registerPreActionHooks
methods.description: Main function that registers a pre-action hook to perform setup tasks before command execution.
